**Serves:** 4\
**Prep time:** 5 minutes

[Sauce]{.badge .badge-sauce} [Vegetarian]{.badge .badge-vegetarian}
:::

*Enjoy with any fish or just by the spoonful.*

## Ingredients

- 1 cup real mayo
- ½ cup onion (finely chopped)
- 2 tsp dill relish
- 2 tsp sweet relish
- ½ jalapeno
- ¼ tsp thyme
- ½ lemon (juice)
- Salt
- Pepper

## Instructions

1. Mix all ingredients together in a bowl.
2. Season to taste.
